newsitem.title: INDIA: CRICKET-PAKISTAN FLAY SRI LANKA BOWLING.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-PAKISTAN FLAY SRI LANKA BOWLING.

text.p: Big-hitting Shahid Afridi and Salim Malik led Pakistan to an imposing 289 for six against Sri Lanka in the Independence Cup one-day tournament on Monday.

Opener Afridi smashed the bowling all around the ground as he raced to 52 off 29 balls. He reached his half-century with successive sixes off strike bowler Chaminda Vass. One reached the sight screen and the other flew over long-off.
Afridi put on 74 for the first wicket with Saeed Anwar, who contributed 36 off 60 balls.

Captain Rameez Raja struck a brisk 49 off 63 balls and Ijaz Ahmed compiled 29 from 45 to maintain the momentum before Salim Malik launched the final assault.He hit four boundaries in his 51-ball knock of 49.
Sanjeeva de Silva's three dismissals at regular intervals prevented Pakistan from reaching the 300 mark. He removed Afridi, Raja and Inzamam-ul-Haq amd conceded 59 runs.
